description: Figure 2 is a pie chart illustrating the original distribution of five emotion categories within the IEMOCAP dataset, with percentages representing their proportion relative to the total number of utterances. The chart is divided into five colored segments: “Frustration” is shown in light blue and accounts for 25.1%; “Neutral” is in dark blue and makes up 23.1%; “Anger” is yellow and represents 14.9%; “Sadness” is orange and comprises 14.7%; and “Happiness” is red and constitutes 8.1%. Each segment is clearly labeled with its corresponding emotion category and percentage value, and the chart includes no legend or additional visual emphasis such as exploded slices. The segments are arranged in a clockwise order starting from the top left, with “Frustration” being the largest segment.
